subject: ClearBank POC: success criteria & plan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: ClearBank POC: success criteria & next steps

Thanks again for the call this morning — really appreciated the context on your workflows. Quick recap and a proposed plan so we can lock timelines: 

POC objective (2-week trial):
- Validate Redwood’s inference runtime for your internal document summarization pipeline.
- Success criteria (proposal):
  - Accuracy: ROUGE/ROUGE-L and a set of 50 hand-labeled samples with >= 85% acceptable outputs (business judgment).
  - Latency: p95 < 300ms for 1k-token prompts.
  - Throughput: sustained 50 req/s with concurrent users (spike to 100 for short bursts).
  - Data handling: all data stays in your VPC; audit logs retained for 30 days.

Proposed evaluation plan and ownership:
- Integration & infra: Dylan (redwood) will provision the private endpoint and run load tests.
- Success criteria & product validation: Alex + Priya (ClearBank) will own acceptance tests.
- Commercials & contracts: Rishi (redwood) will manage terms/PO.

Timeline proposal:
- Kickoff: Tue Jul 13 — 1 hour (technical + test plan).
- Week 1: integration, smoke tests, initial dataset run.
- Week 2: load/QA, iterate on prompts, acceptance sign-off.

Attachments: clearbank_poc_sow_v1.pdf (SOW) and network_requirements_sheet.xlsx.

Can you confirm the success criteria above and whether the proposed kickoff time works? If so, we’ll lock calendar invites and Dylan will send infra prep steps.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Thanks Alex — noted and updated. I’ve added the throughput numbers and a brief compliance note to the SOW. For clarity, here’s the refined acceptance checklist we’ll use during the POC: 

Acceptance checklist (final):
- Business quality: >=85% acceptable on 50 labeled examples (Alex/Priya sign-off).
- Latency: p95 < 300ms at the sample prompt distribution provided by ClearBank.
- Throughput: 50 req/s sustained, handle 100 req/s burst for at least 5 minutes without errors.
- Stability: no endpoint errors > 0.1% over 1 hour of steady load.
- Security: data processed in your private VPC; logs encrypted and retained for 30 days.

Evaluation plan:
1) Dylan will share infra checklist and endpoint details (network rules, firewall rules, IP allowlist).
2) ClearBank provides a sanitized test dataset (up to 5000 docs) and 50 gold-reference samples.
3) Run smoke + load tests (Dylan leads).
4) Business validation: run acceptance checklist, Alex/Priya to confirm.

Action owners:
- Marissa (Redwood): POC project lead, scheduling, and acceptance coordination.
- Dylan (Redwood): infra setup & load testing.
- Rishi (Redwood): commercial lead (term sheet, PO).
- Alex/Priya (ClearBank): product/acceptance.

I’m attaching v1 of the SOW and the network sheet for your network team. Please confirm if anything should change, otherwise I’ll lock the kickoff for Tue Jul 13 at 10:00 AM BST.

Attachments: clearbank_poc_sow_v1.pdf, network_requirements_sheet.xlsx

Best,
Marissa
